emailSubject: FMB News | DA Accelerates ₱4-Billion Clark Food Hub to Cut Logistics Costs | August 17, 2026 | 7:00 AM PHT
headline: Clark National Food Hub Moves Forward as Government Backs Logistics Buildout
seoTitle: Clark National Food Hub Moves Forward | FMB News
seoDescription: The government is advancing the national food hub in Clark, Pampanga, with a verified 2026 budget allocation of ₱2.1 billion for the project.
deck: The project is intended to improve storage, trading and distribution links between farm production and major markets.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Department of Agriculture is moving ahead with development of a national food hub in Clark, Pampanga, designed to strengthen wholesale trading, storage and agricultural logistics.

FMB News is publishing the project with a corrected funding figure: the verified 2026 national budget allocation for the national agricultural food hub in Clark is ₱2.1 billion. The newsroom brief's ₱4-billion figure is not presented as the enacted 2026 allocation.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Clark location is positioned to connect agricultural production areas in Luzon with major transport corridors and urban markets. The project is expected to include logistics and storage infrastructure intended to reduce post-harvest losses and distribution friction.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Better cold-chain and wholesale infrastructure can reduce spoilage and improve market access, although the effect on retail food prices will depend on execution, operating costs and broader supply conditions.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for procurement milestones, construction progress, final project scope and any later appropriations beyond the verified 2026 allocation.
